title: Stock Market Today Live, September 9: Sensex, Nifty remain weak as crude prices rise, IT stocks fall - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates - Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 9th September 2026.

Indian equity benchmarks came under pressure and remained volatile on Wednesday as a sharp rise in crude oil prices and heavy selling in IT stocks weighed on sentiment.

At 1.31 p.m., the Sensex was down 358.30 points, or 0.47 per cent, at 75,219.28, while the Nifty fell 78.95 points, or 0.33 per cent, to 23,556.15.

Nifty IT was the worst-performing sectoral index, down 3 per cent. Brent crude rose 1.6 per cent to $99.5 a barrel, hitting a seven-week high amid heightened West Asia tensions. The sustained rise in crude could intensify inflationary pressures, weigh on the rupee and test corporate margins.

* Nifty futures remain bearish after a strong decline through the week and continued selling pressure after today’s gap-down opening.

* 23,500 is the immediate support for Nifty futures. A decisive break below this level could open the way towards 23,300.

* On the upside, 23,630–23,650 is the first hurdle, followed by 23,680. A sustained move above 23,680 could trigger a recovery towards 23,750–23,800.

* The weak advance/decline ratio of 13/37 and broad-based sectoral weakness favour the bears.

* Nifty IT’s nearly 3 per cent decline is adding to the pressure, while strength in Metal and Oil & Gas remains insufficient to offset broader weakness.

* Trading bias: Sell on rise. Nifty futures could see a minor pullback towards 23,630–23,650 before resuming its decline.

* Key levels: Support: 23,500, 23,300 | Resistance: 23,680, 23,750

Solkit Distillery and Brewery Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Agribio Spirits, commenced its production activities at its manufacturing facility situated at B188A, Mewar Industrial Area, Udaipur, Rajasthan.

Adani Ports has received a LOA for development and operations of two dry bulk berths at Paradip Port, Odisha. The Company has been awarded this LOA for a 30-year concession period through a competitive bidding process.

Bandhan Life Insurance, the life insurance arm of Bandhan Group, launched Bandhan Life iInvest Ultima Plus, a Unit Linked Insurance Plan (ULIP) designed to help customers build long-term wealth while protecting their loved ones. Alongside the plan, the company has also announced the launch of a new Bandhan Life Multi Cap Fund, offering customers another opportunity to participate in India’s long-term growth story. The New Fund Launch (NFL) with an initial Net Asset Value (NAV) of ₹10 per unit will remain open till September 21, 2026.
